name: 全自动短视频剪辑流水线 (AutoVideo-Editor)
description_zh: 全自动短视频与口播视频剪辑流水线。输入文案脚本和素材目录，自动搞定配音、双语字幕、镜头拼接、成片导出与剪映草稿工程。
description_en: End-to-end automated short video editing pipeline: script parsing, TTS voiceover, bilingual subtitles, B-roll alignment, MP4 rendering, and CapCut/JianYing draft project export.
